meta.title: Fix notebook sticky scroll flashing by using single reusable delayer
meta.body_summary: Replace per-event `Delayer` creation with a single reusable delayer instance in notebook sticky scroll to prevent flashing caused by concurrent delayed updates.

perf_labels.notes: Initial fix insufficient; maintainer diagnosed feedback loop; Copilot added recursive update guard; PR open pending re-review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 26 changed lines in a single file, this is a very small targeted fix. It fits a small-step UI performance PR, but the fix was insufficient and required a follow-up commit after maintainer feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer Yoyokrazy commented that the reusable delayer did not fix the flashing; suspected root cause is a layout feedback loop where sticky scroll height changes trigger recursive updates.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate flashing by reusing a single delayer, preventing concurrent delayed updates.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent initially misidentified root cause (debouncing vs recursive layout updates). Required maintainer diagnosis to uncover the feedback loop, indicating limited understanding of complex UI rendering pipelines.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer Yoyokrazy manually tested the fix and observed persistent flashing, provided qualitative root cause hypothesis.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler data; only manual observation reported.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After Yoyokrazy's comment, Copilot added a guard flag `_isUpdatingContent` to prevent recursive scroll fires in commit a842e9d; PR awaiting re-review.

core_change_summary.description: In notebookEditorStickyScroll.ts, replaced per-event `new Delayer(100)` with a single `this.scrollDelayer` reused across scroll events. After feedback, added `_isUpdatingContent` guard to prevent recursive `_onDidScroll.fire()` during content update, breaking flashing feedback loop.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes confined to one file.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: replace Delayer creation with reusable instance (6 additions, 4 deletions).
Feedback commit: add _isUpdatingContent flag to prevent recursive scroll events (14 additions, 2 deletions).

review_signals.summary: Commented that reusable delayer does not fix flashing; suspected layout feedback loop.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot added guard flag to prevent recursive updates.

review_signals.summary: Acknowledged root cause as feedback loop and explained guard flag fix.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with delayer reuse fix, linked to issue.
Yoyokrazy commented within ~23 minutes that fix doesn't work and pointed to potential layout feedback loop.
Copilot responded within ~8 minutes with a new commit adding recursive update guard; PR remains open awaiting re-review.
